name: William Lock
bio: Hi, I'm William, a third-year student studying History and Politics. I'm co-Vice President of Durham EA and Co-ordinator of the Arete Fellowship, a 7-week seminar program which introduces you to the key principles and ideas of Effective Altruism. I'm particularly interested in animal welfare and global health, in my view the greatest moral crises humanity currently faces. Outside of EA I'm Deputy Editor of the student newspaper, Palatinate, and on the executive for Debate and Discussion Society.
